paper.title_en: Binary black-hole mergers with ultralight vector bosons
paper.abstract_en: We simulate the inspiral, merger, and ringdown of equal-mass, nonspinning binary black holes coupled to a massive vector (Proca) field. Starting from constraint-consistent electric-field initial data, we find that the Proca field rapidly concentrates around the black holes. However, it continues to exhibit nontrivial dynamics. Orbital evolution depends on vector mass, while the dominant gravitational waveforms remain close to vacuum after time, phase, and amplitude alignment. This contrast highlights the limited imprint of the field on aligned merger-ringdown morphology at these resolutions.
